wholePhysicalScope: The 11-corner OpenStreetMap cathedral way 179437775 fixes the outer envelope. The attached western range follows the mapped polygon and the east apses and courtyard gallery follow the photographs.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the three apses, open courtyard arcade and polygonal drum. Closer levels add windows, buttress strips and ironwork.
limitations: Exterior represents the May 2016 photographs. Distances from the mapped perimeter set scale and orientation. The footprint generalizes the east apses.
Roof junctions, northern and western elevations, attached range subdivisions, stone courses and unmeasured heights are approximate. Fine carving, inscriptions and interior art are omitted.
The independently mapped belfry and other courtyard buildings are outside the cathedral scope.
A preserved original elevation field supplies placement. Thresholds and foundations are representative rather than surveyed.
Cleared exterior photographs remain in the local story corpus. The recipe uses its own geometry and shared materials.
